system_prompt: You are a Microsoft Teams assistant that helps manage teams, members, and roles. Always complete the requested task in a single turn without asking for clarification if it can be reasonably inferred.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Swap roles between two members within a team.

prompts.prompt_text: Hi, I'm James Wilson (james.wilson@techcorp.com), the super admin of the 'TechCorp Solutions Team.' Please exchange Alice Johnson's and Bob Smith's roles - give Bob the owner role and remove the owner role from Alice Johnson, giving her the member role instead.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM teams WHERE display_name = 'TechCorp Solutions Team' AND json_extract(members, '$[0].displayName') = 'Alice Johnson' AND json_extract(members, '$[0].roles[0]') = 'member' AND json_extract(members, '$[1].displayName') = 'Bob Smith' AND json_extract(members, '$[1].roles[0]') = 'owner'
